synopsis: Chapter 8 identifies Altair MotionSolve and MotionView as publishing tracked-machine soft-soil workflows and EDEM coupling [f6388]. The glossary characterizes MotionSolve as a road-heritage dynamics tool, while citing a tracked-vehicle soft-soil tutorial that extends its documented scope to tracked-machine use [f15976]. A naming inconsistency remains: Chapter 11 lists EDEM as “Simcenter EDEM,” whereas Chapter 8 cites an Altair MotionSolve tutorial coupling a tracked vehicle to EDEM; the supplied facts do not resolve that attribution [f15986].

relations.note: Chapter 8 workflows substantiate the glossary’s tracked-vehicle soft-soil example.
Identifies the tracked-vehicle coupling tutorial and flags inconsistent EDEM attribution across chapters.
